name: Wax-Wane Witness
description: Flying, vigilance. Whenever you gain or lose life during your turn, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
assumptions: Presented the life-gain and life-loss triggers as two separate sentences, since they're modeled as two distinct root trigger nodes with identical downstream effects -- same structural duplication as Carrot Cake's shared-text pair.
notes: Fixed a real gap: PlayerTurn$True ("during YOUR turn") had no handling on triggers at all -- reused the existing cond:your_turn naming already established for Flying's own Condition$PlayerTurn encoding. Verified both trigger nodes now carry cond:your_turn. In blb-success.json.
